== Biography ==
Agnes was born in 1618. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-991|James Glasgow]].

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-991]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Confident for the indexed child and named father; mother and later identity are independently assessed.
